title: A Consuming take() Adapter
prompt: With your `Generator<T>` intact, implement `take(Generator<int> src, int n)` — a **move-only** function returning a Generator that yields at most n values from src. This grades the ownership rule: the adapter must own src by move.

tests.name: take limits the count
tests.hint: Inside the coroutine, loop i in [0, n): if (!src.next()) break; co_yield src.value(); — src is a coroutine parameter, so it lives inside the frame (the safe home from the lesson).

tests.name: take of more than available
tests.hint: The break on !src.next() handles exhaustion before n is reached.
